basic_info.description: Spacious Alamo Square condominium blending classic charm with modern updates. This expansive home offers over 2,400 sq. ft. of beautifully renovated living space, including four bedrooms and two updated bathrooms. Period details abound with elegant hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, fireplaces in the formal parlor and dining room, and a bay window that fills the space with natural light. The renovated kitchen boasts gleaming appliances, a large island, generous storage, and opens to a sunroom overlooking the lush shared garden, perfect for morning coffee. Four gracious bedrooms, two with large, custom closets. Additional features include in-unit laundry, updated electrical, plumbing, and heating systems, plus ample basement storage. One-car leased parking. This special home combines the scale and craftsmanship of a classic San Francisco residence with the comfort and convenience of modern upgrades, all in one of the city's most architecturally iconic neighborhoods. Nearby attractions include Alamo Square Park with its playground and iconic Painted Ladies, the lively diversions of Haight-Ashbury, NOPA, and the Divisadero Corridor, all from a central location with easy access to the best of the City and major commuter routes.
